autoInput.enabled.description: Automatically request English in the terminal and Chinese in chat and dialog inputs.
autoInput.rememberPreferences.descriptio: Remember input language preferences for the current helper session. Observable manual switches are remembered automatically; use preference commands for IMEs whose state cannot be read. Terminals still default to English; code editors are left unchanged.
autoInput.otherInputs.description: Request Chinese in other editable inputs, or preserve their input mode. In preserve mode, only recognized chat inputs and terminals are handled.
autoInput.pollInterval.description: Focus-check interval in milliseconds. Actual switching latency depends on the control and input method.
